versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is machine-checked: extraction/verify_all.py fails if it differs from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json allowlistVersion. pageSpecVersion is enforced as a const inside schema/pagespec.schema.json (verify_all checks the manifest value equals that const). tokenCatalogVersion, tokenPolicyVersion and assetRolesVersion are machine-checked against tokens/llm/token-catalog.json, tokens/llm/token-policy.json and assets/asset-roles.json. repositoryVersion is documentation-only and hand-maintained; nothing checks it. 1.2.0 adds the required PageSpec fields `mode` and `tokens`, so a 1.1.0 PageSpec no longer validates; this was released as a minor bump because no PageSpec exists outside the bundled examples (the same call as 1.1.0).

source.complianceNote: Real, live marketing/waitlist site by a real named author (identified on-page as federic.ooo). Logo, 3D model and textures, meta images, author links and live endpoints are must-not-reproduce / must-not-reuse-live-endpoint (assets/asset-roles.json, pinned in schema/semantic_validate.py). Helvetica Neue / Helvetica Neue Condensed are commercial typefaces: license-required. Real copy appears only in the evidence-reference example and must never be published as the real brand. Do not make this repository public.

sourceStack.original: Webflow export + custom bundle (GSAP 3.13 SplitText / ScrambleTextPlugin / CustomEase, Lenis 1.3.4, OGL WebGL), jQuery-based Webflow runtime for the form, Umami analytics.
sourceStack.clone: React 18 + Vite 5; original Webflow CSS ported to src/styles/webflow.css, global embed CSS in src/index.css; tailwind.config.js holds colour/font tokens but no Tailwind layers are emitted.
sourceStack.note: Recorded for provenance only. No token name, section id, schema field or validator rule depends on the stack.

vcs.note: The source project is a git repository (checked 2026-10-23). design-repo.zip (sibling of this folder) is a generated build artifact listed in the project-root .gitignore and not tracked (git ls-files shows no zip); none is shipped with this version. If one is needed, regenerate it last with the CLI zip tool after verification and confirm with 'git ls-files' that it is still untracked.

qaStatus.motion: all patterns matched within tolerance, including anchor and wheel scroll after the 60fps re-measure (mv.qa.motion-match, mv.qa.anchor-scroll, mv.qa.wheel-scroll)

pageSpecModes.note: PageSpec.mode (required, closed enum). reference = a page for the source brand; generated = a page for any other brand (generation-safe roles only, no source brand, copy or hosts, placeholder URLs on .example/.invalid). See assets/asset-roles.json modes and availability.
